name: wol-highlights
description: Cross-browser WebExtension (Manifest V3) that brings JW Library study highlights directly to Watchtower Online Library (wol.jw.org).
author: Daniel Main <ff-addons@funktional.dev>

scripts.generate:icons: mkdir -p wol-highlights/icons && sips -z 16 16 wol-highlights/icons/icon-48.png --out wol-highlights/icons/icon-16.png && sips -z 32 32 wol-highlights/icons/icon-48.png --out wol-highlights/icons/icon-32.png && sips -z 128 128 wol-highlights/icons/icon-48.png --out wol-highlights/icons/icon-128.png
scripts.build:chrome: mkdir -p dist && npx web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir wol-highlights --artifacts-dir dist --ignore-files test test/**
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:chrome && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const dir='dist';const zip=fs.readdirSync(dir).find((name)=>name.endsWith('.zip'));if(!zip){throw new Error('No zip artifact found in dist');}const from=path.join(dir,zip);const to=path.join(dir,zip.replace(/\.zip$/,'.xpi'));fs.copyFileSync(from,to);console.log('Created', to);"
scripts.build:safari: xcodebuild -project "safari/WOL Highlights/WOL Highlights.xcodeproj" -scheme "WOL Highlights (macOS)" -destination 'platform=macOS' CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:all: npm run clean && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:safari
scripts.lint: npx web-ext lint --source-dir wol-highlights --ignore-files test test/**
